summary: Morris Arking discusses when to say Sefer V'Tachlil on Rosh Hashanah, addressing questions about the first day, the second day, and Shabbat. He reviews sources from the Gemarah, the Midrashim, and the Mekubalim concerning Adam HaRishon, and shares testimonies regarding the custom in various communities.
questions: When is the proper time to say Sefer V'Tachlil on Rosh Hashanah?
Can Sefer V'Tachlil be said on the first day if it falls out on Shabbat?
What should someone do if they are in an area without an Eruv?
Why is late in the day considered the best time for Sefer V'Tachlil?
